source: No stellar pole is adopted in https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06692-3. The display axis is celestial north in the sky plane; no rotation is propagated.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the display axis: the sky-north direction at the star, in the plane of the sky. +X is the display meridian, set so that grid longitude 0 faces the Sun and Earth at the scene epoch; east longitude. No spin is propagated.
qualification: Display orientation only; no measured pole, spin sense or prime meridian is implied.
